title: Write unit tests for jsonStream.ts
description: Create Vitest unit tests for the JSON stream parser. Test valid JSON lines, non-JSON lines, partial JSON buffering, and empty line handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-JSON line returned as text test passes
Empty line returns null test passes
npm test passes all jsonStream.test.ts cases

steps.details: Create test file. Import describe, it, expect from vitest. Import createJsonStreamParser.
Test that '{"type":"text","content":"hello"}' as a single line returns { type: 'json', data: {...} }. Test that a plain text line returns { type: 'text', content: line }.

steps.description: Write tests for partial JSON buffering
steps.details: Create a parser. Call process('{"incomplete') — should return null (buffering). Then call process(':"data"}') — should return the assembled JSON object.
Test empty string returns null. Test that non-JSON lines after a JSON line are handled correctly (buffer resets). Run all tests.
